name: Bangkok
dek: Bangkok Metropolis, WMO 48455, in the city. Don Muang was not merged.
paragraphs: Bangkok Metropolis is WMO 48455, height 3.01 m, position 13°43′35″N, 100°33′36″E. The Thailand sheet uses the same station. Don Muang Airport and Bangkok Port Klong Toei have their own files and were not averaged in.

The highest average high in the table is 35.7 °C, in April. The lowest average low is 23.2 °C, in December. The wettest month by the precipitation column is September, at 335.9 mm, and the driest is December, at 11.6 mm. The plug, currency, time-zone, and entry lines are national and repeat the Thailand sheet.

climate.caption: Station: Bangkok Metropolis, WMO 48455.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. Don Muang Airport (48456) and Bangkok Port Klong Toei (48454) are separate Bangkok files and were not averaged in. Some values are printed without a decimal place, such as 33, and are shown that way.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A, B, C, F and O, 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Thailand at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Thailand, last reviewed October 08, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Baht and the code THB for Thailand.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Thailand one row, Asia/Bangkok. zone1970.tab lists that zone on a row it shares with Christmas Island, Cambodia, Laos, and Vietnam; the zone name is the same in both files.
